english.note: Use this for someone who pesters or presses on stubbornly and will not let go, usually negatively; it can also describe persistently repetitive behaviour directed at someone.

examples.english: They were rejected several times but remained persistent, calling every day.
examples.traditional: 佢俾人拒絕咗幾次，仲死纏爛打咁日日打電話嚟。
